start.title: The King's Messengers
start.text:
Moab's envoys arrive with gold.
"Curse Israel for our king."

choices.text: Accept the gold without asking
choices.feedback: Silver dazzles; God is silent.

choices.text: Send them away with a vague vow
choices.feedback: Half-hearted answers serve no one.

choices.text: Ask the Lord what to say
choices.feedback: Numbers 22:8 — Balaam asked the Lord what he should say.

greed_consequence.title: Gold Cannot Buy His Word
greed_consequence.text:
His mouth is not for sale.
Kneel and ask Him first.

choices.text: Ask the Lord what to say
choices.feedback: Silence falls in your tent.

vague_consequence.title: Speak Plainly Before Him
vague_consequence.text:
Half-truths help no man.
Go to the Lord directly.

choices.text: Ask the Lord what to say
choices.feedback: You wait on His answer.

first_word.title: "Do Not Go"
first_word.text:
The Lord says, "Bless, do not curse."
The envoys ride home empty.

choices.text: Send messengers chasing the king's gold
choices.feedback: Your heart already drifts.

choices.text: Tell new envoys what God said
choices.feedback: Numbers 22:13 — Balaam told the princes that the Lord refused to let him go with them.

chase_consequence.title: Stay Where He Set You
chase_consequence.text:
Wages cannot weigh against His word.
Wait for His messengers instead.

choices.text: Tell new envoys what God said
choices.feedback: You speak only what was given.

second_offer.title: Princes at Your Door
second_offer.text:
Greater nobles come, greater gold.
"Name your price," they say.

choices.text: Pretend you never heard the first word
choices.feedback: His word does not unsay itself.

choices.text: Refuse, even for a house of silver
choices.feedback: Numbers 22:18 — Balaam told Balak's servants that he could not go beyond the word of the Lord his God, even if Balak gave him his house full of silver and gold.

choices.text: Demand a higher fee in secret
choices.feedback: Greed is a louder god than truth.

pretend_consequence.title: His Word Stands
pretend_consequence.text:
You cannot bury what He spoke.
Answer with truth.

choices.text: Refuse, even for a house of silver
choices.feedback: The princes hear you firmly.

fee_consequence.title: No Price for Prophecy
fee_consequence.text:
His mouth is not a marketplace.
Let your refusal be plain.

choices.text: Refuse, even for a house of silver
choices.feedback: Their faces darken at your word.

saddle_donkey.title: Yet You Saddle the Donkey
saddle_donkey.text:
Their gold still glitters in your mind.
You ride toward Moab anyway.

choices.text: Turn back and stay in your tent
choices.feedback: Numbers 22:19-20 — Balaam should have stayed the night to hear what the Lord would say to him next, rather than saddling his donkey and going with the men.

choices.text: Press on, planning what to say
choices.feedback: The road grows uneasy.

narrow_path.title: The Donkey Stops
narrow_path.text:
She bolts into a field.
You see only stubborn beast.

choices.text: Beat her back onto the road
choices.feedback: You strike what you cannot see.

choices.text: Pause and ask why she fears
choices.feedback: Numbers 22:23 — The donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way with his drawn sword, and she turned aside out of the way.

humbled_early.title: A Glimpse of Light
humbled_early.text:
The road shimmers with hidden warning.
Fear of God softens your heart.

choices.text: Continue with humility
choices.feedback: Your eyes will soon be opened.

second_block.title: Crushed Against the Wall
second_block.text:
She presses your foot to the stone.
Pain blinds you further.

choices.text: Curse her and beat her again
choices.feedback: Your anger grows; your sight does not.

choices.text: Stop and listen to the silence
choices.feedback: Numbers 22:25 — The donkey saw the angel of the Lord and pressed herself against the wall, crushing Balaam's foot.

third_block.title: She Lies Down Beneath You
third_block.text:
The donkey will not rise.
Then her mouth opens.

choices.text: Strike her one more time
choices.feedback: Hardness will not save you now.

choices.text: Hear her words in fear
choices.feedback: Numbers 22:28 — The Lord opened the mouth of the donkey, and she spoke to Balaam.

choices.text: Laugh and call it madness
choices.feedback: Mockery cannot dim the truth.

strike_consequence.title: Your Hand Falls Empty
strike_consequence.text:
Three times you have struck her.
Now listen to what she says.

choices.text: Hear her words in fear
choices.feedback: Your staff lowers slowly.

laugh_consequence.title: This Is No Madness
laugh_consequence.text:
The Lord opened her mouth.
Close your own and listen.

choices.text: Hear her words in fear
choices.feedback: The laughter dies on your lips.

angel_revealed.title: Your Eyes Are Opened
angel_revealed.text:
An angel stands, sword drawn.
"Your way is perverse before Me."

choices.text: Defend yourself with proud excuses
choices.feedback: Truth needs no defense from you.

choices.text: Bow your face to the dust
choices.feedback: Numbers 22:31 — Balaam bowed his head and fell on his face when the Lord opened his eyes and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way.

choices.text: Beg him for the king's gold instead
choices.feedback: Even now your heart is divided.

defend_consequence.title: Lower Your Pride
defend_consequence.text:
His sword shines truer than your words.
Kneel and confess.

choices.text: Bow your face to the dust
choices.feedback: You sink to the rocky ground.

beg_consequence.title: Let Go of the Gold
beg_consequence.text:
Silver cannot stand before His blade.
Repent before you speak again.

choices.text: Bow your face to the dust
choices.feedback: Your hands open and empty.

ending_obedient.title: The Tent at Dawn
ending_obedient.text:
You stayed where He set you.
No blade. No blindness. Only peace.

ending_humbled.title: "Speak Only What I Tell You"
ending_humbled.text:
The angel sheathes his sword.
You ride on, His word in your mouth.
